title: useLayoutEffect blocks paint: use it sparingly

slides.say: Use layout effect is powerful, but it has a price.

slides.text: Its code and every state update it schedules block the browser from repainting.
slides.say: The code inside it, and all state updates it schedules, block the browser from repainting. Overuse it and your app feels slow.

slides.text: Set state inside it? React runs all remaining Effects immediately, including useEffect.
slides.say: And if you set state inside it, React runs all remaining Effects right away, including use effect ones.

slides.text: On the server there is no layout. Prefer useEffect when you can.
slides.say: It also does nothing useful on the server, where there is no layout. When possible, prefer use effect.
